title: Bikewatching
description: An interactive map of Boston Bluebikes traffic built with Mapbox and D3. Station circles are sized by trips and colored by departures vs. arrivals, with a slider to filter by time of day.

title: Portfolio Website
description: A personal portfolio site built in DSC 106 with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, featuring a JS-generated nav and a dark mode switcher.

title: DSC 106 Project 1: Static Visualization
description: A static visualization that tells a clear story with an effective title and annotations.

title: NBA Lottery Pick Survival Analysis
description: Eclipse Data Science project using survival analysis to predict All-Star outcomes for NBA lottery picks.

title: EV Sports Analysis Project
description: Used cross-reference techniques to analyze player performance data.
